title.narrative: Integrated Social Protection Inclusion and Resilience Project (INSPIRE)

description.narrative: The Project development objectives (PDO) are to increase the efficiency of integrated social protection services and to promote economic inclusion and access to shock-responsive assistance, including climate shocks, for the poor and extreme poor, and in case of an Eligible Crisis or Emergency, respond promptly and effectively to it.

The objectives of the Integrated Social Protection Inclusion and Resilience Project for Dominican Republic are to increase the efficiency of integrated social protection services and to promote economic inclusion and access to shock-responsive assistance, including climate shocks, for the poor and extreme poor, and in case of an eligible crisis or emergency, respond promptly and effectively to it. There are five components to the project, the first component being promoting human capital and increased resilience against shocks, including climate shocks, through cash transfers. This component includes two subcomponents: supporting anti-poverty strategy and cash transfer program, Former PROSOLI Program (SUPERATE) cash transfers, supporting SUPERATE emergency transfers. The second component is the promoting economic inclusion of vulnerable youth. This component includes three subcomponents: life skills and financial literacy training, labor market orientation, and mentoring, learning courses and apprenticeship for wage employment, self-employment, and micro-entrepreneurship for income-generating activities. The third component is the improving the efficiency of the delivery of integrated social protection services. This component includes three subcomponents: transformation of SIUBEN, modernization of payment system, and strengthening of SUPERATE's capacity to improve service delivery. The fourth component is the project administration and evaluation. Finally, the fifth component is the contingent emergency response component.

condition.narrative: Section I.A.1.(b) of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. No later than four (4) months after the Effective Date, hire or appoint, asapplicable, the following additional staff as part of the PIU: a Project Coordinator, a financial management specialist, aprocurement specialist, and a social specialist, all with qualifications, experience, and terms of reference satisfactory to theBank, as further set forth in the Operational Manual.

Section I.A.1.(c) of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. No later than six (6) months after the Effective Date, hire or appoint, asapplicable, the following additional staff as part of the PIU: a contract management specialist, a monitoring and evaluationspecialist, a strategic planning specialist, and a social specialist with experience on environmental management, all withqualifications, experience, and terms of reference satisfactory to the Bank, as further set forth in the Operational Manual.

Section I.A.1.(d) of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. No later than three (3) months after the Effective Date: (a) create, andthereafter maintain throughout each calendar year of Project implementation, specific budget line entries in the national annualbudget to keep track of the corresponding expenditures financed out of Loan proceeds incurred during Project implementation; and(b) establish, and thereafter maintain throughout the implementation of the Project, accounting, reporting, and internal controlprocesses acceptable to the Bank, all in accordance with the criteria set forth in the Operational Manual.

Section I.A.1.(e) of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. No later than four (4) months after the Effective Date, hire and retain,throughout Project implementation, independent auditor(s) in number and with experience and qualifications acceptable to the Bank,for purposes of carrying out audits of the Project in accordance with terms of reference set forth in the Operational Manual, andconsistently applied auditing standards, all acceptable to the Bank.

Sections I.A.2 (a), (b.i), (b.iii), and (c) of Schedule 2 to the Loan Agreement. No later than two (2) months after the EffectiveDate, enter into an inter-institutional agreement with ADESS, INFOTEP, MoL, and SIUBEN under terms and conditions acceptable to theBank.
